title: Resetting your password
content: If you cannot log in because you forgot your password, select Forgot Password on the login page. Enter your registered email address to receive a password reset link.

title: Background jobs are not running
content: If background jobs are not running, check whether the worker process is active. Confirm that the worker can connect to Redis and that the queue name matches the application configuration.

title: Uploading documents
content: To upload documents, open the Documents page and select Upload. This demo application accepts PDF and TXT files. The maximum file size is 10 MB.
